title: Navy gun-camera videos off San Diego

tellings.quote: I see on television with these Navy gun cameras that are picking up off San Diego, the the thing traveling at warp speed, diving into the ocean.

plain: Navy gun-camera footage filmed off San Diego shows something travelling at what he calls "warp speed" and then diving into the ocean, according to John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy. He tells Michels he saw the video on television, so he is describing broadcast footage, not anything he saw firsthand or through his office.
